newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS UNDERPERFORM BUNDS, MARKKA STEADY.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS UNDERPERFORM BUNDS, MARKKA STEADY.

text.p: calmer midsession trade on Friday after coming under pressure
from a big domestic seller early on, dealers said.
"There was lively selling earlier, but it's calmer now," one
said. Confirmation from France that it would miss the deficit
target for economic and monetary union (EMU) was widely expected
and had no effect, dealers said: the focus was switching back
towards bunds and the Fed's FOMC meeting next week.
The markka was steady and quiet: dealers saw it trading in a
2.980-2.995 range for the rest of the session.
